region_estimates: Five-region shares and uncertainty ranges transcribed from submitted EDA notebook outputs; estimated_t renormalized to exactly 232000 tonnes using the displayed shares. Rounded P05/P95 intervals are from original 2000 Dirichlet weight scenarios; not validated confidence intervals.
national_total_source: NEA Waste Statistics and Overall Recycling, 2025; https://www.nea.gov.sg/our-services/waste-management/waste-statistics-and-overall-recycling
trees: Trees.sg 2021 community archive, attributed to NParks, from original notebook; 695912 area-matched records
planning_areas: URA MP2019 from original notebook, not shipped with this package because original processed GeoPackage was not uploaded
model_score: R2 0.364, MAE 0.997 in log(1+tonnes of managed tree biomass proxy / grid cell); 5-fold GroupKFold by planning area; not waste prediction
site_coordinates: Representative illustrative map anchors by region, not actual land parcels, approved sites or GIS-calculated centroids
routing: Haversine from supply area proxy to hub anchor * user assumed multiplier + first-last-mile distance; not Singapore road routing
carbon: The 0.372 tCO2 wet-t stored and 0.095 tCO2e wet-t net benefit are worked-case results reported in original interim document. 0.100 and 0.177 split of their 0.277 difference is a new illustrative parameter decomposition, not verified lifecycle inventory.
economics: S$92 revenue and S$310 cost per wet tonne from interim illustrative worked case, not site quotations. Additional hub overhead and travel cost are user scenarios.
carbon_credits: No issuance, eligibility, methodology match or market price has been demonstrated. Singapore carbon tax is not a carbon credit sales price.
validation_status: No independent regional 2025 operator record supplied; operational validation pending.
